title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of Justice, and the National Health and Family Planning Commission on Issuing the Opinions on Punishing Illegal and Criminal Activities Involving Medical Services According to Law and Maintaining Normal Medical Order
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate, Ministry of Public Security

Ministry of Justice, National Health and Family Planning Commission

Notice on Issuing the "Opinions on Punishing Crimes against Medical Personnel and Maintaining Normal Medical Order according to Law"

Fa Fa [2014] No. 5

All High People's Courts, People's Procuratorates, Public Security Departments (Bureaus), Judicial Departments (Bureaus), and Health and Family Planning Commissions (Health Departments) of provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army, the Military Procuratorate; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; the People's Procuratorate, Public Security Bureau, Judicial Bureau, and Health Bureau of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

To punish crimes against medical personnel according to law, maintain normal medical order, and build a harmonious doctor-patient relationship, the Supreme People's Court, the Supreme People's Procuratorate, the Ministry of Public Security, the Ministry of Justice, and the National Health and Family Planning Commission, after in-depth investigation and research and extensive solicitation of opinions, have formulated the "Opinions on Punishing Crimes against Medical Personnel and Maintaining Normal Medical Order according to Law." This document is now issued to you. Please organize study earnestly and ensure implementation.

April 22, 2014

Opinions on Punishing Crimes against Medical Personnel and Maintaining Normal Medical Order according to Law

To punish crimes against medical personnel according to law, maintain normal medical order, and build a harmonious doctor-patient relationship, these Opinions are formulated in accordance with the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China, the Public Security Administration Punishments Law of the People's Republic of China, and other laws and regulations, and in light of work practice.

I. Fully Recognize the Importance of Punishing Crimes against Medical Personnel and Maintaining Normal Medical Order according to Law

Strengthening the construction of medical and health services is an important social construction project to ensure the people's access to medical care and to improve the health level of the entire population. After years of efforts, significant achievements have been made in China's medical and health services, but there remains a certain gap between medical service capacity and medical security level, on the one hand, and the people's growing demand for medical services, on the other. Over a period of time, criminal acts such as violent homicide or injury of medical personnel, and gathering crowds to create disturbances in medical institutions have occurred in some localities, severely disrupting normal medical order and infringing upon the legitimate rights and interests of the people. Good medical order is an important manifestation of social harmony and stability, and also an objective requirement for enhancing people's well-being. Punishing crimes against medical personnel according to law and maintaining normal medical order are conducive to protecting the legitimate rights and interests of both doctors and patients, creating a good environment for patients to seek medical treatment, and providing a safe practice environment for medical personnel, thereby promoting the overall improvement of medical service levels and the healthy development of medical and health services.

II. Strictly Punish Crimes against Medical Personnel according to Law

Crimes against medical personnel shall be seriously investigated and resolutely cracked down upon according to law. Public security organs shall intensify the investigation and punishment of criminal activities such as violent homicide or injury of medical personnel, and disruption of medical order. Upon receiving an alarm, they shall promptly dispatch police and quickly handle the situation. If criminal liability is to be pursued, they shall promptly file a case for investigation, comprehensively and objectively collect and obtain evidence, and ensure the quality of the investigation. People's procuratorates shall promptly approve arrests and initiate prosecutions according to law, strengthen legal supervision over major criminal cases against medical personnel, and where necessary, may provide opinions on evidence collection and application of law. People's courts shall accelerate the trial process, accurately determine guilt and impose sentences according to law based on a comprehensive finding of the facts of the case. For defendants with cruel criminal methods, deep subjective malice, and high personal dangerousness, or for criminal acts against medical personnel with a bad social impact, punishment shall be severe according to law.

(1) Anyone who assaults a medical worker within a medical institution, or intentionally injures the body of a medical worker, or intentionally damages public or private property, without causing serious consequences, shall be punished respectively in accordance with Articles 43 and 49 of the Public Security Administration Punishments Law; anyone who intentionally kills a medical worker, or intentionally injures a medical worker causing minor injury or more serious consequences, or wantonly assaults a medical worker under despicable circumstances, or wantonly damages public or private property under serious circumstances, constituting the crime of intentional homicide, the crime of intentional injury, the crime of intentional destruction of property, or the crime of picking quarrels and provoking troubles, shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Criminal Law.

(2) Anyone who sets up a mourning hall, places wreaths, burns paper money, hangs banners, blocks gates, or otherwise disrupts medical order within a medical institution, without causing serious losses, and who fails to comply after persuasion and warnings, shall be dispersed according to law, and those who refuse to obey shall be removed from the scene according to law and punished in accordance with Article 23 of the Public Security Administration Punishments Law; if the act is carried out by a crowd, the principal offenders and other active participants shall be punished under public security administration; if serious losses are caused or serious disruption of other public order occurs, constituting the crime of picking quarrels and provoking troubles, the crime of gathering a crowd to disrupt social order, or the crime of gathering a crowd to disrupt order in public places or traffic order, the offender shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Criminal Law.

Those who illegally park a corpse in hospital wards, emergency rooms, intensive care units, or other areas within a medical institution or in public open areas of a medical institution, affecting medical order, and who fail to comply after persuasion and warnings, shall be punished in accordance with Article 65 of the Public Security Administration Punishments Law; if the act seriously disrupts medical order or other public order and constitutes a crime, the offender shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph.

(3) Anyone who illegally restricts the personal freedom of a medical worker by means such as preventing them from leaving the workplace shall be punished in accordance with Article 40 of the Public Security Administration Punishments Law; if the act constitutes the crime of unlawful detention, the offender shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Criminal Law.

(4) Anyone who publicly insults or intimidates a medical worker shall be punished in accordance with Article 42 of the Public Security Administration Punishments Law; if the act of publicly insulting or intimidating a medical worker by violence or other methods is serious (despicable), constituting the crime of insult or the crime of picking quarrels and provoking troubles, the offender shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Criminal Law.

(5) Anyone who illegally brings guns, ammunition, controlled instruments, or explosive, radioactive, toxic, or corrosive substances into a medical institution shall be punished in accordance with Articles 30 and 32 of the Public Security Administration Punishments Law; if the act endangers public safety and is serious, constituting the crime of illegally bringing guns, ammunition, controlled knives, or dangerous substances endangering public safety, the offender shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Criminal Law.

(6) Anyone who intentionally escalates the situation, instigates others to commit illegal or criminal acts against a medical institution or medical worker, or commits extortion, picking quarrels and provoking troubles, or other acts in the name of handling a medical dispute on behalf of another, shall be severely punished in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Public Security Administration Punishments Law and the Criminal Law.

III. Actively Prevent and Properly Handle Medical Disputes

(1) The health and family planning administrative department shall strengthen the supervision of the medical industry, guide medical institutions to improve their medical service capacity, and ensure medical safety and medical quality. Medical institutions and their medical workers shall strictly abide by medical and health management laws, administrative regulations, departmental rules, and diagnosis and treatment nursing norms, strengthen the construction of medical ethics and style, improve service attitudes, pay attention to humanistic care, respect patients' rights to privacy, information, and choice, and communicate appropriately according to the patient's condition, prognosis, and actual needs, and do a good job of explanation and reasoning, so as to prevent and reduce medical disputes at the source.

(2) The health and family planning administrative department shall guide medical institutions to strengthen complaint management, establish a doctor-patient relationship office or designate a department to uniformly undertake complaint management work in medical institutions, and establish smooth and convenient complaint channels.

The complaint management department of a medical institution shall prominently display the contact information of its department and relevant institutions such as the people's mediation organization for medical disputes, and the procedures for resolving medical disputes, increase the promotion of legal knowledge to patients, and guide patients to resolve medical disputes legally and rationally. Medical institutions with the conditions may set up online complaint platforms and arrange for special personnel to handle and respond to patient complaints. We must ensure that every complaint is handled and responded to, and provide feedback to the complainant on the handling situation within the specified time limit.

For medical disputes that cannot be resolved through self-negotiation between the doctor and patient, the medical institution shall promptly seek resolution through other legal channels, such as applying for mediation by the people's mediation committee.

(3) The judicial administrative department shall, together with the health and family planning administrative department, accelerate the construction of people's mediation organizations for medical disputes, and establish independent people's mediation committees for medical disputes in areas with concentrated medical institutions and prominent medical disputes.

The judicial administrative department shall, together with the people's courts, strengthen the guidance of people's mediation committees for medical disputes, help improve various work systems such as acceptance, mediation, follow-up visits, and feedback for people's mediation of medical disputes, strengthen the team building and professional training of people's mediators for medical disputes, and establish expert consultation databases in medicine and law, to ensure that mediation is carried out legally, normatively, and effectively.

The judicial administrative department shall organize legal aid institutions to provide legal aid to patients with medical disputes and their families who have needs and meet the conditions, guide law firms, notary offices, etc. to provide legal services to parties to medical disputes, guide lawyers to do a good job of representation, and promote the parties to a medical dispute to properly resolve the dispute.

(4) People's courts shall promptly accept and file cases for lawsuits for medical damages, actively carry out litigation mediation, and where mediation fails, promptly render judgments according to law, and effectively protect the legitimate rights and interests of both doctors and patients. During the litigation process, litigation guidance shall be strengthened, and post-judgment explanations shall be provided.

(5) The health and family planning administrative department shall, together with the public security organs, guide medical institutions to establish and improve emergency response mechanisms for sudden events and a police-medical joint prevention and control mechanism, and improve the on-site handling capacity for emergencies. Public security organs may set up police offices in medical institutions as needed, promptly accept reports and requests for assistance related to medical incidents, and strengthen dynamic control. When medical institutions discover patients with violent tendencies during diagnosis and treatment, or discover that conflicts have escalated during the handling of medical disputes, which may lead to public security or criminal cases, they shall promptly report to the public security organs.

IV. Establish and Improve a Mechanism for Coordination and Cooperation

All relevant departments shall attach great importance to the importance of cracking down on crimes against medical personnel and maintaining normal medical order, earnestly implement the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee and the State Council on building a harmonious doctor-patient relationship, strengthen organizational leadership and coordination and cooperation, and form a joint force for building a harmonious doctor-patient relationship. Health and family planning administrative departments at or above the prefectural level shall actively coordinate relevant departments to establish work systems such as joint meetings, regularly exchange information, study and solve problems in a timely manner, jointly maintain medical order, and promote the healthy development of China's medical and health services.
